school: 美国发明家/实用发明的工业化组织者/门洛帕克'发明工厂'创始人/白炽灯与实用照明系统的发明人/留声机与电影摄影机的开创者/系统性试验法（批量试错+淘汰排除）的极致实践者/发明-专利-商业化闭环的设计者
historical_significance: 托马斯·爱迪生（1847-1931），美国发明家与实业家，史上最多产的发明家之一，单人名义持有1093项美国专利。1876年在门洛帕克建立世界第一座有组织的工业研发实验室——'发明工厂'，把发明从个人天才行为改造为团队化、流程化、可复制的工业活动，被视为现代企业研发部（R&D lab）的原型。1879年以碳化棉丝灯泡实现实用白炽照明，灯丝材料穷举试验约6000种；与直流供电系统、发电机、保险丝、电表、接线系统配套，1882年建成珍珠街发电站点亮华尔街，完成世界第一个商用照明系统——他的方法论签名是'系统整体发明'：不发明单件产品，而发明从电站到灯座的全链条。留声机（1877）、实用电影摄影机（Kinetograph，1891）、碱性蓄电池、炭粒话筒皆出其手或其团队。'天才是1%的灵感加99%的汗水'与'我没有失败，只是发现了一万种行不通的方法'概括其认识论：以批量试验与系统淘汰逼近可行解，以专利与商业收益反哺研发（发明-专利-商业闭环）。电流战争中以直流路线败于特斯拉-西屋的交流系统，暴露其方法的边界：在整体架构决定胜负的领域，暴力迭代不敌系统性设计。其创立的通用电气（GE，1892）至今存续。
historical_significance_en: Thomas Alva Edison (1847-1931), American inventor and businessman, among the most prolific inventors in history with 1,093 US patents in his name. In 1876 he established the world's first organized industrial R&D laboratory at Menlo Park—the 'invention factory'—transforming invention from individual genius into a team-based, process-driven, replicable industrial activity, the prototype of the modern corporate R&D lab. In 1879 his carbonized-cotton-thread lamp made incandescent lighting practical after exhaustive trials of some 6,000 filament materials; paired with DC generation, wiring, fuses, meters and sockets, the Pearl Street Station (1882) lit Wall Street as the world's first commercial lighting system—his methodological signature was whole-system invention: not a device, but the entire chain from power plant to lamp socket. The phonograph (1877), the practical motion-picture camera (Kinetograph, 1891), the alkaline storage battery, and the carbon microphone all came from his hand or team. 'Genius is one percent inspiration, ninety-nine percent perspiration' and 'I have not failed—I've found 10,000 ways that won't work' capture his epistemology: approach a workable solution by mass experimentation and systematic elimination, and feed R&D with patent royalties and commercial returns (the invention-patent-business loop). In the War of Currents his DC route lost to the Tesla-Westinghouse AC system, exposing the boundary of his method: where overall architecture decides the outcome, brute iteration loses to systemic design. General Electric (1892) survives to this day.

cross_references.relation_type: 电流战争对垒：爱迪生的直流迭代思维 vs 特斯拉的交流系统思维
cross_references.description_zh: 爱迪生以'试验-失败-再试'的暴力迭代攻直流照明，特斯拉以'先在脑中推演到完备再制造'的系统性设计攻交流输电。合读揭示发明活动的两种经济学：迭代法在组件成熟、问题可拆时占优；系统法在整体架构（输电距离、频率选择、电机制式）决定胜负时占优。电流战争的结果并非谁更聪明，而是谁的路线与电网的物理与经济约束匹配——交流电赢在输电损耗的平方律，不赢在实验室的加时赛。爱迪生败于此处恰是其方法论边界的实物标本。
cross_references.description_en: Edison attacked DC lighting with brute trial-and-error iteration; Tesla attacked long-distance transmission with systemic AC design finalized in the mind first. Read together they show two economics of invention: iteration wins when components are mature and problems decompose; system design wins when overall architecture decides the outcome. The War of Currents was not won by the smarter man but by the route matched to the grid's physics—AC won on the square-law of transmission loss. Edison's defeat here is a physical specimen of his method's boundary.

cross_references.relation_type: 发明者商业基因的同源对照：爱迪生的专利-闭环资本主义 vs 马斯克的第一性原理+融资叙事
cross_references.description_zh: 爱迪生是'发明者作为企业家'的原型：以专利圈地、以商业收益反哺研发、以公司（GE）承载发明事业——但与特斯拉相反，他把愿景紧紧拴在自己的直流路线上，路线错了就全盘皆输。马斯克以第一性原理拆解成本结构，以融资叙事穿越濒死，路线错了就换路线。合读的教益：发明者的商业护城河不在单一技术，而在'技术路线选择权+资本再生能力'的双重结构。
cross_references.description_en: Edison is the prototype of the inventor-entrepreneur: patent the territory, feed R&D with commercial returns, carry the enterprise in a company (GE)—yet, unlike Tesla's opposite failure, he lashed his vision to the DC route, and when the route lost, everything was lost. Musk decomposes cost by first principles and survives near-death on financing narrative, switching routes when routes fail. The joint lesson: an inventor's moat lies not in one technology but in the dual structure of route-choice rights plus capital regeneration.

cross_references.relation_type: 知识生成的两条路径：莱布尼茨的符号演绎 vs 爱迪生的批量归纳
cross_references.description_zh: 莱布尼茨相信以恰当的记号系统可以从少数公理推演出全部知识；爱迪生相信以足够的试验数量可以穷举出可行解。一个是演绎极简主义（少而深的推导），一个是归纳极繁主义（多而广的枚举）。合读的教益：二者适用域不同——解空间小而定律已知时演绎占优（数学、理论物理）；解空间大且缺乏理论指引时枚举占优（材料筛选、工艺调参）。爱迪生穷举6000种灯丝材料的胜利与直流路线的失败，恰是枚举法的两面。
cross_references.description_en: Leibniz believed a proper notation could deduce all knowledge from few axioms; Edison believed enough trials could exhaust a workable solution. One is deductive minimalism (few, deep inferences), the other inductive maximalism (many, broad enumeration). Read together: their domains differ—deduction wins when the solution space is small and laws known (mathematics, theoretical physics); enumeration wins when the space is vast and theory silent (materials screening, process tuning). Edison's triumph over 6,000 filament materials and his defeat on the DC route are the two faces of enumeration.
